envelope.description: Add the pane's rule for a reference posted by its companion frame

body.title: Add the pane's rule for a reference posted by its companion frame
body.summary: In vscode-plugin/src/chat/docs-review-panel.ts, add rvFrameMessage and register it as a window message handler: it acts only when the message's source is the current companion frame's contentWindow, the type is 'insrc-open-code-ref', the path is a non-empty string of bounded length and the line, when present, is a positive integer. It then posts the existing open-code-ref payload to the host. The frame keeps sandbox allow-scripts only; the host's check is untouched. The pane rule stands on its own: it is exercised by posting the frame message straight to the window handler, not through a page.
acceptanceChecks: A test that posts the frame message directly to the pane's window handler, from the companion frame's window, with a valid path and line sees the same path and line posted to the host as an open-code-ref message
A message from any other window, or with a missing, non-string or oversized path, or a line that is not a positive integer, is ignored
The frame is still created with sandbox 'allow-scripts' only, and the existing docs-companion, docs-content and decision messages are handled as before
